name: Xal'thuun
title: Dream-Seeker
abilityWindow: During the "Movement" step of any players tactical action
abilityText: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to choose 1 non-home system that contains an anomaly. That player ignores any movement effects of that anomaly in that system during this tactical action.

name: Thul'morah
title: The Awakened One
abilityWindow: When you cast votes on an agenda
abilityText: Cast an additional number of votes equal to the number of planets in systems that contain 1 or more of your nexus tokens.
unlockCondition: Have ships in 2 different non-nebula anomalies.

name: Shuulgoroth
title: The Nightmare Made Flesh
abilityText: Place or move up to 3 nexus tokens into any non-home systems. Then, you may place your flagship and up to 3 destroyers in any system that contains a planet you control. If that system contains another player's ships, resolve combat. Then, purge this card.

name: Shardwright Veyla
title: Fleet Control
abilityWindow: At the end of a player's tactical action
abilityText: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to place a number of fighters from their reinforcements in the active system up to the number of non-fighter ships in that system. If that player was another player, capture that many fighters from the supply.

name: High Architect Lumina
title: Lightkeeper
abilityText: You may place them in any system that contains 1 or more of your ships, your command token, and no other players ships.
unlockCondition: Have 12 fighters on the game board.

name: Facet
title: Hive Mind Nexus
abilityText: You may return any number of captured fighters from your faction sheet to place any number of units in any systems that contain at least 1 of your ships with a total cost of up to twice the amount of fighters returned. Then, purge this card.

name: Orrun
title: Ash-Tender
abilityWindow: After a player's ship is destroyed during combat
abilityText: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to place 1 unit of that type from their reinforcements in a different system that contains at least 1 of their ships.

name: Karos
title: Ember-Guide
abilityWindow: When you roll for a units' BOMBARDMENT ability
abilityText: For each hit produced, before applying modifiers, either gain 1 commodity or convert 1 commodity to a trade good.
unlockCondition: Produce at least 1 hit during a BOMBARDMENT roll.

name: Asera
title: Flame-Warden
abilityText: Choose 1 system. Each of your units on the game board may use its BOMBARDMENT against each planet in that system. Then, purge this card.

name: Shipwright Kastel
title: Master of Supply
abilityText: Choose a player and exhaust this card. You may allow that player to produce 1 unit in a system that contains one of their units with PRODUCTION, reducing the cost of the produced unit by 1.

name: Captain Vakros
title: Master of Logistics
abilityText: Your mechs do not count against capacity when being transported or when in a space area that contains 1 or more of your ships with capacity. While your mechs are in the space area of a system they have PRODUCTION 1.
unlockCondition: Have a salvage card in your play area.

name: Admiral Thalen
title: Master of Iron
abilityText: Ready each planet that contains 1 of your units with PRODUCTION. Then, resolve PRODUCTION in one of those systems. Then, purge this card.

name: Len
title: Appraiser
abilityText: Exhaust this card and choose a player. That player may select a planet they control and reveal the top card from a matching exploration deck. If it is an attachment, attach it to that planet. Otherwise, discard it and gain 2 trade goods.

name: Zul
title: Grand Architect
abilityText: Gain 1 commodity. If the explored planet has an attachment, you may convert that commodity to a trade good.
unlockCondition: Control 4 planets that have an attachment.

name: Zat
title: Architect Savant
abilityText: Attach the Grand Design card to a planet in your home system. Explore and ready each planet with a design attached to it. Then, purge this card.

name: Zor No-ahn
title: Systems Specialist
abilityWindow: When any player gains a technology
abilityText: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to return that technology to their technology deck and gain 1 technology of a different color with the same number of prerequisites.

name: Tek Mir-un
title: Tech Junkie
abilityWindow: When you perform the secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card
abilityText: You do not spend a command token.
unlockCondition: Own 1 technology in each color owned by at least 1 other player.

name: Ky Lir-et
title: The Technocrat
abilityText: For each player that has a token on your faction sheet, you may remove it to either gain 1 of that player’s technologies, or force that player to return 1 technology of your choice to their technology deck.

name: Serael
title: The Shepherd
abilityWindow: After a player activates a system
abilityText: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to choose 1 system that contains a non-home anomaly. That player may treat that system as adjacent to the active system during this tactical action.

name: Kaethos
title: The Unyielding
abilityText: Ongoing
abilityWindow: You may treat anomalies as if they contained an ingress token.
unlockCondition: Take control of a planet in The Fracture.

name: Naethu
title: The First Voice
abilityText: Place this card near the game board. During this game round, your ships may move out of anomalies that contain your command tokens. At the end of this game round, purge this card.
